{{Quote|This Terror Brigade is always looking for a new combat thrill: unarmed ambushes, wrestling wampas, they've done it all. Recently assaulted an Imperial base for kicks. Captured Moff Yoren, one of the Empire's chief strategists. Now they're offering to ransom him off to us.|Lieutenant [[Calia]]|<ref name="TOR:TTB" />}}
'''Yoren''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was captured during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Terror Brigade]] group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and offered conditionally to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR:TTB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Despite being described as a Moff, Yoren's carbonite is labeled as "Grand Moff."<ref name="TOR:TTB" />
